General Information

What is This Part?
This is the Exterior Door Handles for both the Drivers Side and the Passengers Side.
ALL STEEL Construction to meet the most rugged demand.
Exterior handles may require spacers and slight modification. Spacers are included and go between door panel and handle frame.

Qty 1 – LH Exterior Handle
Qty 1 – RH Exterior Handle
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
